title: Sequins Long Sleeve Asymmetrical Hem Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Sparkle and shine in this stunning evening dress! Featuring fitted sleeves, shimmering sequins, and an elegant asymmetrical hem, this design effortlessly combines sophistication and allure. Perfect for formal events, it?¡¥s your go-to choice for making a dazzling entrance!

 

Size Tips: Choose based on bust and waist measurements first. 


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Fitted sleeve.
